what: aifoundry1 card 0's price per flipped B mantissa bit at 600 MHz (static TDP 0) against its own 800 MHz
telemetry_profile: no-PMIC-read: sampler and config without GET_ASIC_VOLTAGE / GET_MODULE_VOLTAGE; voltages from sp.minion_mv[0]

e60_card0_800MHz.note: only lq_h0/h2/h8 ran on this card at 800 MHz, so the per-designed-bit slope is the h2 -> h8 secant

V1.claim: the 600 MHz price per flipped mantissa bit = card 0's own 800 MHz price x (V600/V800)^2: the flip's energy follows the voltage, not the clock (E72's registered form)
V1.quantity: lq h2 -> h8 secant, board, fJ per designed flipped bit, registered leak auto
V1.pass_if: inside the band AND outside the alternative's band; inside both = INCONCLUSIVE

V1m.claim: PRIMARY. The same test with both sides reduced at the same leakage slope on fixed pass sets (E72 correction C2)
V1m.pass_if: E118's secant at each registered slope (on E118's passes kept at both) inside that slope's band: PASS at both, PARTIAL at one, FAIL at neither; re-evaluated at the measured V600

V2.claim: the same on the minion rail (uncorrected, E72's caveat)

V3.claim: the watts of a rung scale as f*V^2 (the clock is in the watts)

V4.claim: the ladder bends as on the two cards measured at 600 MHz
V4.quantity: full h >= 1 slope / h2 -> h8 secant, board

V5.claim: the busy ladder costs more per bit than lq by the two cards' factor
V5.quantity: lb full slope / lq full slope

V6.claim: the turn-on is dearer with a busy partner
V6.quantity: lb_h1 / lq_h1 in watts over their zeros

C1.claim: the same-session 800 MHz control agrees with E60's 20 Oct rows on this card
C1.pass_if: both d_p80 inside +-10%; else V1 is also reported against today's control, said so

G1.claim: the pin: TDP 0 holds the clock at the vmin-LUT floor
G1.predicted: 600 MHz in 100% of samples of every pinned launch; zero 'Power throttle up' events in the SP ring between the dump before the pin and the dump after the last pinned pass
G1.pass_if: both halves; a ring that wrapped between the dumps leaves the log half UNMEASURED (not PASS)

G2.claim: the pinned voltage is the LUT's 600 MHz point
G2.quantity: mean sp.minion_mv[0] of the kept pinned runs

G3.predicted: TDP 65 W and threshold 65 C read back; the return burst reaches >= 700 MHz; >= 1 'Power throttle up' event in the ring between the dump after the pinned passes and the dump after the return burst

V1s.claim: REPORTED, NOT SCORED: V1 against today's 800 MHz control instead of E60's rows
V1s.quantity: E118 600 MHz secant / E118 800 MHz control secant vs (V600/V800_session)^2
